newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ajaccio airport says Jan-Oct air cargo up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ajaccio airport says Jan-Oct air cargo up 12 pct.

text.p: Ajaccio's Campo dell'Oro airport said it handled 3,400 tonnes of airfreight in the first 10 months of 1996, an increase of 12.0 percent on the same period last year.
The principal airline at Ajaccio airport is Air France Europe which operates daily passenger services from Paris using Airbus 320 series aircraft.

Ajaccio is also served by French airline, Air Littoral, which operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft.
The HS748 operates a nightly Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio to Marseille itinerary.

French carrier, L'Aeropostale, operates nightly Paris-CDG/Marseille-Ajaccio-Marseille-Paris/CDG rotations carrying documents and parcel shipments on behalf of express operator, TAT Express and also postal freight using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.

January-October 1996 postal traffic handled at Ajaccio airport totalled 3,123 tonnes, up 17.7 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
